CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.description: This field is used to soft delete lead records after certains days.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Originator__c, 'UNICA'), ISPICKVAL(Lead_Originator__c, 'Adobe') ), IF( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c, 'Expired'), true, IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c, 'No Opportunity'), DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 5 < TODAY() ), true, IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c, 'Referred'), DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 60 < TODAY() ), true, false ) ) ), IF( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Originator__c, 'CCRM'), IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c, 'Expired'), DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 365 < TODAY() ), true, IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c, 'No Opportunity'), DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 365 < TODAY() ), true, IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c, 'Referred'), DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 60 < TODAY() ), true, false ) ) ), false ) )
CustomField.label: Soft Delete
